title: The Confession of Windrow House
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Sable Brightwater, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
